BiblicalUsage: Zizah is the second son of Shimei the Gershonite Levite, named in David's ordering of the Levites. The verse before calls the same man Zina, so Zizah is Zina under a second spelling — one Levite, two forms of his name. His place was second among his brothers, and his service was in the house of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts the second son as surely as the first, and that a name spelled two ways is still one man known to Him.
